hints.title: Greedy Earliest Subarray Completion
hints.text: To maximize non-overlapping subarrays, finish and claim valid subarrays as early as possible.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Lookup Reset
hints.text: Track prefix sums in a lookup collection. Whenever prefix - target is present, a valid target subarray has just closed.

hints.title: Reset Active Lookup
hints.text: Increment the count, clear the lookup collection, and re-insert the current prefix sum to restart fresh for future subarrays.

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rechecking all subarray sums naively takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash set lookup achieves O(1) checks per element with immediate greedy clearance.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate proves greedy earliest-finish-time property and resets prefix state after each match.
complexity.notes: Subarrays must be non-empty and mutually disjoint.
